title: Utility Meter-to-Billing Pipeline
caption: Field device readings land in staging, pass validation and estimation rules, and load a dimensional model that feeds billing and usage reporting.

title: Public-Sector Reporting Warehouse
caption: Departmental source systems load into shared dimensions and a governed semantic layer, so every published dashboard uses the same definitions.

title: Insurance and Payroll Reconciliation
caption: Records from two systems of record are matched by rule, exceptions go to a review queue, and resolved items post to a reconciled ledger.

title: Requirements to Validation Method
caption: Business requirements are mapped field by field, built into transformations, checked with automated validation queries, and signed off before release.

title: Legacy System Migration
caption: Legacy data is extracted, profiled, and mapped, then run in parallel with the new platform and checked for variances before cutover.

title: Governed Data Platform Hub
caption: Source systems load into one governed platform, and dashboards, models, and partner feeds read from it under shared catalog and access rules.

title: Layered Data Platform Stack
caption: Data moves up from raw storage through cleaned, modeled, and semantic layers to reports, and each layer has a named owner.

title: Utility Usage Star Schema
caption: One usage fact table joins to meter, date, account, rate plan, and premise dimensions through surrogate keys.

title: Validated Request Sequence
caption: A request fails a validation rule, is corrected and resubmitted, passes, and is written to the system of record.

title: Record Lifecycle Loop
caption: Each record is received and validated, failed records go to exceptions and are corrected, and clean records are reconciled and archived.

title: Point-to-Point vs Integration Layer
caption: The same five systems shown wired directly to each other, then connected through one integration layer with a single contract per system.

title: Current State and Target State
caption: The current setup moves data by export and rekeying, and the target routes both applications through one API into a shared warehouse.

title: Integration Pattern Map
caption: One system of record serves consumers three ways: a synchronous API, an event queue, and a scheduled file drop.

title: Security and Access Boundary
caption: Requests sign in through an identity provider, roles decide what a user can see, and sensitive fields are masked before data leaves the boundary.

title: Ingestion with Quality Gates
caption: Files and API payloads land first, a schema check passes good loads to the warehouse, and failures go to quarantine for steward review.

title: Orchestrated Batch Pipeline
caption: A nightly schedule runs jobs in dependency order, retries a failed step, and sends an alert when retries run out.

title: Change Data Capture to Warehouse
caption: A log reader streams source changes to a queue, a merge job writes a new version for each changed row, and a current view shows the latest rows.

title: Request to Approval Process
caption: A request moves from the requester through operations review and finance approval, and the system posts the result and generates a letter.

title: Exception Handling Loop
caption: Unmatched records go to a queue for analyst review, are corrected and resubmitted to the matcher, and matched records post and close.

title: Document Intake Automation
caption: Inbound documents are read by text extraction, valid fields update the system of record, and failed fields go to manual keying.

title: Layered Analytics Modeling
caption: Sources feed reusable staging and intermediate models, which build mart tables, a semantic layer, and dashboards, with docs kept alongside.

title: Test and Deploy Workflow
caption: Each model change goes through review and automated tests, passing changes deploy to production, and the docs site rebuilds from the deployed models.

title: Metric Definition Governance
caption: A business question becomes a written metric definition, the owner signs it off, and only then does it become a certified dataset for reports.
